subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should plugin Control UI pages become a separate registerControlUiEntryPoint/Gateway launch API, or should this work be folded into the existing Control UI descriptor/tab contract after the security hardening is applied?
rationale: The branch adds a new public plugin UI contract that overlaps current tab descriptors and changes the trust model for plugin-owned UI, so automation cannot choose the permanent API boundary or acceptable browser isolation model.

options.title: Fold into descriptor/tab model
options.body: Use the existing descriptor surface as the canonical plugin UI entry contract and add only the launch-token and sandbox pieces that descriptor tabs cannot already express.

options.title: Approve a separate entry-point API
options.body: Keep registerControlUiEntryPoint as a new SDK/Gateway contract, but require iframe-only rendering, opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch handling, docs, and exact-head browser proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for the native-page RFC
options.body: Close or pause this PR until the broader native/plugin Control UI page direction in the open RFC and native-page issue is resolved.

recommendation.title: Fold into descriptor/tab model
recommendation.body: Use the existing descriptor surface as the canonical plugin UI entry contract and add only the launch-token and sandbox pieces that descriptor tabs cannot already express.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the generic host-hook foundation and are the clearest owner for deciding whether this new UI contract belongs in that plugin SDK family.
